# unbound_local_zone (Data Source)

Configured local-zone data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unbound_local_zone" "example_com" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the zone

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the zone
- `type` (String) Type of the zone
